title: Lagniappe at Blue Mountain
meta_description: A stylish retreat in Blue Mountain Beach with outdoor kitchen, pool access, and just minutes from 30A dining and sugar-white sands.
description_expanded:
"Lagniappe" is the Gulf Coast's word for "a little something extra" --- and this gated, four-bedroom retreat in The Village at Blue Mountain Beach delivers it. Tucked into one of South Walton's most easygoing 30A neighborhoods, between Santa Rosa Beach and Grayton Beach, it sits just a short walk or bike ride from sugar-white sand, the 19-mile Timpoochee Trail, and a cluster of local coffee shops and restaurants right at the neighborhood's edge.

Inside, the open-concept main floor is built for the kind of trip where everyone ends up in the same room. Plush seating gathers around a Roku-equipped TV for slow mornings and movie nights, while the kitchen handles the heavy lifting: stainless steel appliances, an island with seating for six, and a custom dining table that comfortably seats ten --- room enough for the whole group to land in one place after a day in the sun.

Upstairs, four bedrooms sleep ten without anyone drawing the short straw. Two king suites come with private ensuite baths --- one featuring a spa-like soaking tub made for unwinding --- while a third king room and a queen-over-queen bunk room share a Jack-and-Jill bath, an easy setup for families traveling together. Every bedroom has its own Smart TV, so quiet time is always within reach.

Outside is where Lagniappe earns its name. The full outdoor kitchen --- built-in grill, griddle, sink, and refrigerator --- turns dinner into an event, and a freestanding gas grill on the back patio keeps quick meals simple. Patio seating for six is ready for morning coffee or golden-hour gatherings, and an outdoor shower means sandy feet never make it past the door. Steps away, the community's amenities --- a sparkling pool, bocce and shuffleboard courts, and a fitness center --- round out the days you'd rather not stray far.

A secure, tech-enabled lockbox ensures seamless entry without compromising the home's hurricane-rated doors and windows.

When you're ready to roam, Blue Mountain Beach is moments away --- part of South Walton's celebrated Blue Wave--certified coastline, known for its natural beauty and unhurried, family-friendly feel. Start the morning with pastries from Blue Mountain Bakery, pick up fresh-off-the-boat seafood at Goatfeathers, and cap the night with a scoop from Blue Mountain Beach Creamery. Grayton Beach State Park, Seaside, and the rest of 30A's beloved stops sit just minutes down the road.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach.

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Please note that bikes are not provided. Guests may rent them through our preferred vendor, LIV Adventures.
- Pack 'n play is available upon request

Parking Details:
- Guests will have access to 2 driveway parking spots during their stay. Please note that street parking is not available.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
